title: Austin's 1871 Mayor Change & Budget Approvals
summary:
• **New Mayor Appointed**: Homer H. Gleason was officially commissioned as Austin's new mayor by Texas Governor C.S. Davis, replacing outgoing Mayor Leander Brown.

• **Budget Passed**: The city council unanimously approved $784.25 in spending to cover government salaries, police pay, jail expenses, and infrastructure maintenance.

• **Farewell Resolution**: Council members unanimously passed a formal resolution thanking outgoing Mayor Brown for his "long and faithful services" and courteous leadership.

• **Key City Expenses**: Major budget items included officer salaries, prisoner care ($75), bridge maintenance and construction, and dead animal removal services.
